exit 2
--- stdout
--- stderr
error: profile "alerts" is a webhook for spaces/AAAATestSpace, and it cannot post to spaces/BBBBSomewhereElse.
A webhook is issued for one space and is the only thing that authenticates the request, so there is no version of this that reaches another one.
Use a profile whose webhook is for spaces/BBBBSomewhereElse, or leave the target off to post to spaces/AAAATestSpace.
